resting.videoZoneSub: or press to choose one · MP4 or WebM, up to 2 MB
resting.capNoteText: The size limit on this step is this server, not the shop. Shoppable video allows a video of 64 MB, but PHP on this server accepts at most 2M per file (upload_max_filesize) and 8M per whole request (post_max_size), so 2 MB is the real ceiling today. The cover and the teaser are held to the same two numbers. A bigger file is thrown away by PHP before this shop sees any of it. That is why an upload can reach 100% and still fail: the bytes leave your browser and never arrive. Raise it on the server, not here. On Cloudways: Servers → Settings & Packages → Basic → Upload Size, or put upload_max_filesize and post_max_size in a user ini file in the web root over SSH. Then reload this screen. This note disappears and the box goes back to saying 64 MB.
